title: Dilation invariance of an integer multiplicity cone: mass scaling, support and density
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity C) and a cone (IsConeCurrent C: currentEval(η_{0,λ#}C, ω) = C(ω) for every λ > 0 and every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), where η_{0,λ#}C = blowUp C 0 λ). Then for every real s > 0: (1) M_{sW}(C) = ofReal(s^n)·M_W(C) for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P, where sW = {s·x : x ∈ W} and M_W = massOn (values in [0, ∞]); (2) s·x ∈ spt C if and only if x ∈ spt C, for every x ∈ ℝ^P; (3) HasMassDensity C (s·x) θ if and only if HasMassDensity C x θ, for every x ∈ ℝ^P and θ ∈ ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), C.massOn ((fun x => s • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) * C.massOn W) ∧ (∀ x : Euclid P, s • x ∈ C.support ↔ x ∈ C.support) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), HasMassDensity C (s • x) θ ↔ HasMassDensity C x θ
